hypothesis: Regex pattern `GRANT .* ON` lacks re.DOTALL and requires `authenticated` immediately after `TO`. When standard multi-line SQL or official Supabase templates (`TO anon, authenticated;`) are used in new migrations, the sentinel falsely flags valid migrations as security violations, breaking CI builds.
RLS activation pattern `ALTER TABLE public.{table} ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` rejects standard defensive SQL variants containing `IF EXISTS` or `ONLY`, rejecting valid migrations.
